procedure: cargo test --locked --workspace; governance five-seat apportionment and status-quo ties, plus end-to-end board meeting, CEO nomination/removal, authority and large-action approval workflows. limitations: Five seats and controller-held authority thresholds are simplified; no proxy solicitation or shareholder proposals.
